description:
"Invoke the Rites of Moawita, replacing your Light and Heavy Attacks with healing abilities that can be used on allies.

Your Light Attacks heal for |cffffff3056|r.

Your Heavy Attacks heal for |cffffff2716|r every |cffffff1|r second, and restore |cffffff1155|r Magicka to you for successfully healing.

You heal yourself for |cffffff51|r% of the amount of healing done to the ally."
